say: A sheet of particles, pinned to the back of her head, held together by links, and pulled down by gravity.
At first it shimmered. Here's roughly how: one physics step per frame, with whatever time that frame took.
Frame times wobble, so the physics wobbled too. And the pinned row jumped straight to her head every frame.
Now the cloth steps at a fixed two hundred and forty hertz. The pins glide between frames, and drawing blends the last two states.
